config_text:
hostname branch-r1
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description Uplink
 ip address 10.0.0.1 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.0.0.2
line vty 0 4
 transport input ssh
 login local
!
service password-encryption
ip domain-name corp.local
username admin privilege 15 secret 0 SuperSecret123
